description_en: Queries the details of a specified O&M task
description_zh: 查询指定运维任务详细信息
name: GetAutoOpsTask

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the O&M task that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的运维任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Task.description_en: The details of the O&M task

AllowedOverTime.description_en: The time when the approval of the O&M task was completed. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
AllowedOverTime.description_zh: 运维任务审批完成的时间（秒，时间戳格式）

Comment.description_en: The remarks of the O&M task

Name.description_en: The name of the O&M task

ScheduleTimeInfo.description_en:
The execution plan of the O&M task.
ExecAt: If the value of ScheduleType is Manual, this parameter is not meaningful. If the value of ScheduleType is FixTime, this parameter indicates the scheduled execution time in seconds as a UNIX timestamp. If the value of ScheduleType is CycleInterval, this parameter indicates the first execution time in seconds as a UNIX timestamp.

PeriodNum: If the value of ScheduleType is Manual or FixTime, this parameter is not meaningful. If the value of ScheduleType is CycleInterval, this parameter indicates the interval for periodic execution.

PeriodUnit: If the value of ScheduleType is Manual or FixTime, this parameter is not meaningful. If the value of ScheduleType is CycleInterval, this parameter indicates the unit of the periodic execution interval. Valid values: hour and day
ScheduleTimeInfo.description_zh:
运维任务的执行计划。
ExecAt：当ScheduleType返回值为Manual时，本参数无意义；当ScheduleType返回值为FixTime时，表示定时执行的时间（秒，时间戳格式）；当ScheduleType返回值为CycleInterval时，表示首次执行的时间（秒，时间戳格式）。

PeriodNum：当ScheduleType返回值为Manual或FixTime时，本参数无意义；当ScheduleType返回值为CycleInterval时，表示周期执行的时间间隔。

PeriodUnit：当ScheduleType返回值为Manual或FixTime时，本参数无意义；当ScheduleType返回值为CycleInterval时，表示周期执行的间隔单位，hour为小时，day为天

ScheduleType.description_en:
The scheduling type of the task.
FixTime: scheduled execution.
CycleInterval: periodic execution.
Manual: manual execution triggered by the user
ScheduleType.description_zh:
任务的调度类型。
FixTime：定时执行。
CycleInterval：周期执行。
Manual：由用户手动触发执行

Script.description_en: The content of the script to be executed by the O&M task. The value is Base64-encoded
Script.description_zh: 运维任务要执行的脚本内容。经Base64编码后返回

ScriptId.description_en: The ID of the script associated with the O&M task. This parameter is returned only when ScriptType is set to SpecificScript
ScriptId.description_zh: 运维任务关联的脚本ID。当ScriptType取值为SpecificScript时本参数有返回值

ScriptName.description_en: The name of the script associated with the O&M task
ScriptName.description_zh: 运维任务关联的脚本名称

ScriptType.description_en:
The script type of the O&M task.

HandInput: manually entered script.

SpecificScript: associated existing script
ScriptType.description_zh:
运维任务的脚本类型。

HandInput：手动输入脚本。

SpecificScript：关联已有脚本

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the O&M task

TaskState.description_en:
The status of the O&M task.

PendingApproval: pending approval.
Rejected: rejected.
Cancelled: cancelled.
PendingExecution: approved and waiting for execution.
PrepareRun: preparing to execute.
Running: executing.
Completed: execution completed.
Failed: execution failed
TaskState.description_zh:
运维任务状态。

PendingApproval：待审批。
Rejected：已拒绝。
Cancelled：已撤销。
PendingExecution：审批通过，等待执行。
PrepareRun：准备执行。
Running：执行中。
Completed：执行完成。
Failed：执行失败
